gbm_population_evidence.quote: Only patients with confirmed IDH wild-type glioma will be enrolled in this study.

candidate_evidence.quote: Randomized Study of Neo-adjuvant and Adjuvant Pembrolizumab With and Without Targeted Blood Brain Barrier Opening Using Exablate MRI-guided Focused Ultrasound (Exablate MRgFUS) for Recurrent Glioblastoma

candidate_flag.reason: Pembrolizumab is given in both arms; candidate status rests on device-enabled delivery being the question (C12) and the stated pembrolizumab antitumour objective.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To assess efficacy of BBB opening as measured by drug levels of pembrolizumab in target brain tumor tissue

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess efficacy of BBB opening with Exablate MRgFUS to enhance intratumoral effector T-cell infiltration during neo-adjuvant and adjuvant pembrolizumab

role_evidence.quote: To determine anti-tumor activity of pembrolizumab in recurrent glioblastoma
To learn if the Exablate Model 4000 Type 2 ("Exablate System") with the DEFINITY® ultrasound contrast agent can temporarily disrupt the blood brain barrier

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast microbubbles for focused-ultrasound BBB opening

source_quote.quote: Only patients with confirmed IDH wild-type glioma will be enrolled in this study.

coder_notes: Perflutren (Definity) is not a registered intervention but is named in the brief summary as part of the FUS BBB-opening procedure, so listed as delivery-enabling in the FUS arm. Ctdna/immune biomarkers in exploratory objectives are not specific tumour molecular markers and were not coded. Registered intervention for the FUS arm is a device row named with pembrolizumab; coded as pembrolizumab in both arms.
